findings.quoted_text: Within 30 days of the end of each quarter during the term of this agreement, PACIFICAP ENTERTAINMENT shall receive from THE HENRY FILM AND ENTERTAINMENT CORPORATION, a detailed accounting statement showing Net Due and Paid Shared Revenues for that quarter and shall remit to PACIFICAP ENTERTAINMENT its share of such revenues.

findings.explanation: Payment is deferred on a quarterly basis and conditioned on the client collecting revenues, which delays your funds well beyond 30 days and ties your payment to third-party collections.
findings.suggested_change: Within thirty (30) days following the end of each month, the Client shall provide a detailed accounting statement and remit the Licensor's share of net revenues.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for providing the agreement. I am happy to move forward once we make a minor adjustment. - Regarding the relevant clause, payment is deferred on a quarterly basis and conditioned on collections, which delays funds; I propose modifying this so that within thirty (30) days following the end of each month, the Client shall provide a detailed accounting statement and remit the Licensor's share of net revenues. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
